description: Automated Snow Weather Station Locations is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Monitoring and Analysis Branch. Locations of automated snow weather stations, active and inactive. Automated snow weather stations are components of the BC snow survey network. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Monitoring and Analysis Branch. Its tags are automated snow pillows, automated snow weather stations, climate related monitoring, cryosphere, hydrology. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
